identity.description: Front is a customer service platform where support teams and AI agents work together across email, chat, SMS and WhatsApp, with shared inboxes, ticketing, and a REST API.
identity.identity_notes: Sources describe Front (front.com) customer service platform. Developer Portal is linked in the nav but its URL is not given in the sources.

access.production_restrictions: API rate limit increases are a paid add-on ($200 per 100 API requests/min per month).

api.rate_limits: Core API rate limit can be increased via add-on: $200 per 100 API requests/min per month.

claims.quote: Through our flexible, robust REST API and 160+ integrations, Front connects your CRM (including Salesforce), core apps, and external systems directly to customer conversations.
Our free 14-day trial offers all the features available in our Professional plan. You can get started without a credit card and can upgrade at any time during your trial.
MCP server Connect AI tools to Front so they can securely access your conversations and data
